Subject: Renewal QBR + Roadmap — session bundling & exec bridge

Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the positive renewal conversation last week. To keep things tight for your team, I wanted to propose a bundled plan for the Renewal QBR + Roadmap review so we minimize calendar churn for your execs and engineering leads.

Proposal (high level):
- Two back-to-back sessions on the same morning (we'll record both):
  1) Technical deep-dive (45–50 min): performance, integration checklist, migration notes
  2) Executive roadmap (40–50 min): product priorities, roadmap timeline, ROI highlights
- Short 10–15 minute buffer between sessions for quick break / internal regroup
- Redwood to host an "exec bridge" for the roadmap session if your C-suite wants a focused join for the first 20 minutes.

Suggested windows (PT):
- Option A: Tue 10 Jun, 09:00–10:40 (two sessions + 10 min buffer)
- Option B: Wed 11 Jun, 08:30–10:10
- Option C: Thu 12 Jun, 11:00–12:40

I've attached a draft agenda (QBR_Agenda_v2.pdf) and a short slide deck with demo topics (demo-slides-draft.pptx). Can you confirm which window works and whether you want the exec bridge? If you prefer a single 90-min compressed session instead, say so and we'll propose a run-of-show.

Thanks —
Mina
Mina Haddad

Hi Mina —

Thanks for the clear options. High level: leadership would prefer fewer context switches, so a compressed approach is attractive. Our execs can do one block in the morning only (they're tight after 11am). That said, our engineering and infra leads want a proper deep-dive and might step out during the executive portion.

Request: can we do back-to-back sessions in the morning (so engineering can join the first one and execs can come in for the second without two separate days)? Ideally start 09:00 PT. If you record both, that satisfies anyone who misses parts.

Also: please make sure someone from Redwood can host the recording / standby as we may have last-minute attendee swaps.

I'll pencil Tue 10 Jun 09:00 PT for now — confirm if that works and then send calendar invites including dial-in + recording link.

Appreciate it —
Alex

- Ben, can you own recording + provide a standby host in case Laura or I need to step into another meeting?

If that plan looks good to everyone, I'll send the calendar invites and a shared Drive link with pre-reads.

Cheers —
